expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is hard-clipped at the right screen edge with its title and image cut off mid-character, giving no clear visual cue that the row is scrollable.
In the bottom navigation bar, the system home-indicator bar overlaps the search (magnifier) icon, making the icon appear struck-through and visually broken.
The truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' uses an ellipsis that cuts the word awkwardly; combined with the edge clipping it reads as a rendering glitch rather than intentional truncation.
The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) is also cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll affordance.

expected.reasoning: Issue 1 describes the bottom navigation bar where the system home-indicator bar (gesture bar) overlaps the search icon, matching the expected defect of gesture bar overlapping bottom nav icons.
